title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account and organization.
languageSubtitle: Choose how SequrAI speaks to you. Product names stay in English.
mcpSubtitle: Ask "Can I deploy?" from Cursor, Claude Code, or VS Code — without leaving your editor.
mcpPromoTitle: Use SequrAI in your code agent
mcpPromoBody: Ask "Can I deploy?", audit your app, and get Safe Fix prompts without leaving your editor.
mcpStep1Done: Step 1 done — your private connection key is ready
mcpBeforeConnect: We create a private key for you. Then you run one command in your project folder. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, and VS Code.
mcpStep2Body: Open the terminal in your project folder, paste the command, and press Enter. Then restart your agent (Cursor: quit fully; Claude Code: restart and run /mcp).
mcpCommandCopied: Copied — paste it in your project terminal
mcpKeyOnceNote: Your key is inside the command. We won't show it again separately.
mcpTroubleshootingRestart: Cursor: quit fully and reopen. Claude Code: restart and run /mcp — the install command embeds your API key in Authorization (no OAuth client id).
mcpTroubleshootingGreen: Cursor: Settings → Tools & MCP — “sequrai” green. Claude Code: /mcp — “sequrai” connected.
mcpTroubleshootingFolder: Run the command from the folder where your code lives, not inside the SequrAI app
mcpManualToggle: I'd rather set it up manually
mcpManualStep1: Claude Code and VS Code: HTTP with your API key in the Authorization header. Cursor: use the install command above (stdio bridge).
mcpSecurityNote: Don't share the command — it contains your private key.
mcpRegenerateHint: Already connected? Revoke an old connection and click Connect my agent again to get a fresh command.
workspaceManageDescription: Switch between Workspaces you can access.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account, workspace data, and cancel any active subscription.
